cat << 'EOF' > app.py
import os
import io
import tempfile
import uvicorn
from typing import List, Optional
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File, Form, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel

app = FastAPI(title="DreamVoice Transcription Sidecar")

PORT = int(os.getenv("SERVER_PORT", "8000"))
MODEL_SIZE = os.getenv("WHISPER_MODEL", "base")
DEVICE = os.getenv("DEVICE", "cpu")
COMPUTE_TYPE = os.getenv("COMPUTE_TYPE", "int8")

print(f"[DreamVoice] Loading Whisper model '{MODEL_SIZE}' on {DEVICE} ({COMPUTE_TYPE})...")
model = WhisperModel(MODEL_SIZE, device=DEVICE, compute_type=COMPUTE_TYPE)
print("[DreamVoice] Model ready! Listening on port", PORT)

class SegmentModel(BaseModel):
    start: float
    end: float
    text: str

class TranscriptionResponse(BaseModel):
    language: str
    duration: float
    text: str
    segments: List[SegmentModel]

@app.get("/health")
def health():
    return {"status": "ok", "model": MODEL_SIZE, "device": DEVICE}

@app.post("/transcribe", response_model=TranscriptionResponse)
async def transcribe_audio(file: UploadFile = File(...), language: Optional[str] = Form(None)):
    try:
        suffix = os.path.splitext(file.filename)[1] if file.filename else ".wav"
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=suffix) as temp_file:
            content = await file.read()
            temp_file.write(content)
            temp_path = temp_file.name
        try:
            segments_generator, info = model.transcribe(
                temp_path,
                beam_size=5,
                language=language if language and language.strip() else None,
                vad_filter=True
            )
            segments = []
            full_text = []
            for s in segments_generator:
                cleaned = s.text.strip()
                if cleaned:
                    segments.append(SegmentModel(start=round(s.start, 2), end=round(s.end, 2), text=cleaned))
                    full_text.append(cleaned)
            return TranscriptionResponse(
                language=info.language,
                duration=round(info.duration, 2),
                text=" ".join(full_text),
                segments=segments
            )
        finally:
            if os.path.exists(temp_path):
                os.remove(temp_path)
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=PORT)
EOF

pip install -U --prefix .local -r requirements.txt
echo -e "[DreamVoice] Setup completed!"
exit 0
